main_text.p: לָכַד Capere, Occupare. Niphal נִלְכַּד Capi. Hithpahel הִתְלַכֵּד Continere, Intercipere se, Concrescere.
לִמַּד Discera. Pihel לִמֵּד Discere facit, Decuit. Pyhal לֻמַּד Doceri.
לָמוּד לְמוּד m. Doctus, Eruditus, Assuetus : plur. לְמוּדִים. תַּלְמִיד m. Discipulus.
לָעַג Subsannare, Irridere. Niphal נִלְעַג Irideri. Hiphil הִלְעִיג ut antè.
לַעֲנִים לַעַג m. Subsannatio : Sannio : plur. Sanniones, Ridiculi.
לוּעַז לַעַז m. Barbarus, barbari sermonis.
לַפִּיד לַפֵּר masc. Lampas, Teda : plurale, לַפִּידִים.
לָפַת Apprehendere, Complecti. Niphal נִלְפַּת Contorquere, Inclinare se.
לָקַח Capere, Accipere, Sumere, Assumere. Niphal נִלְקַח , Sumi, Capi. Pyhal לֻקַּח & Hophal הוּקַח idem. Hithpahel הִתְלַקֵּח

page.notes: Vowel points and dagesh marks in the Hebrew are small and partly blurred on the scan; some may differ in detail. The page is damaged by stains at the left and right edges, but all entries are legible.
